scope: Temporarily audition the selected ordinary ADPCM channel while keeping the PSF paused, its Live view frozen, and the authored editor bank intact.

behavior.pausedLiveOn: Keyboard uses selected CH and Reference key, without Capture or PSF Stop. CH and Reference changes retire the previous trial.
behavior.pausedLiveOff: Keyboard uses the authored editor instrument while the PSF remains paused. Normal keyboard notes update physical PITCH normally.
behavior.resume: Fade and release the temporary trial, restore the editor checkpoint, and continue the retained song position.
behavior.playingKeyboard: Existing keyboard behavior still stops a running song before playing the editor instrument.
behavior.capture: Explicit Capture remains permanent; restore the authored bank before sample-cache/capacity preflight.
behavior.voiceRules: Same-frame ADPCM bytes, ADSR, voice volumes and send, plus Reference-key tuning reuse the existing Capture helper. Each key starts a fresh envelope.
behavior.sharedEffects: Editor shared reverb and Master are retained; custom song-wide reverb and song main volumes are not copied.
behavior.failure: Report the reason while retaining the paused source and authored sound; never fall back silently to another instrument.

ownership.checkpoint: Existing getPs1Client temporary bank; original RAM, sample identities, software waveform/morph, host PCM, ADSR and FX restore through its checkpoint.
ownership.sourceMachine: Temporary trials do not write the PSF CPU/RAM, schedule source buffers, stop source buffers, or advance its frozen position.
ownership.guard: Private readonly ownsOutput fences fade/cleanup against newer clients, editor writes and replacement engines.

additionalFix.trigger: Code used earlier, then Capture while already in Keyboard mode.
additionalFix.cause: Redundant setMode(keyboard) stopped an existing runtime and closed the shared Code output gate; unchanged mode skipped its reopen callback.
additionalFix.fix: Only request the mode change when currently in Code mode.
additionalFix.validation: Both engines produce finite nonzero permanent-Capture PCM behind the mandatory physical mute.
